codeFindings.detail: For 3dcart durhamoutdoors, stream-page-count is RIGHT (does ID-dedup walk -> 389, matching the true unique count). sitemap is WRONG: PCP:295 counts ALL <loc> with no product filter -> 442 for this site; the product subset is only 147 (62% undercount). The R1-blind candidate's productCountMethod=sitemap would yield a badly wrong count. DB's stream-page-count is correct. Note generic-product-sitemap (filtered to _p_) would give 147 — still a hard undercount because the 3dcart sitemap lists only a recent/partial product subset (matches testing-api-tester persona lesson: shift4shop/3dcart sitemap undercounts).

Both 'sitemap' and 'stream-page-count' are canonical valid method names (no silent-null risk for this site, unlike the Wave-1 dual-api/wp-rest-api strings). The issue here is method CHOICE (sitemap undercounts), not an unrecognized-string null.

Adapter resolution = adapters[siteInfo.adapterType] || adapters.generic. Keys on adapterType COLUMN, not siteProfile.platform. Retagging platform custom->shift4shop-3dcart is zero-risk to routing (adapterType stays generic-retail). The registry refresh emits a drift WARNING when adapterType!=platform; retag silences it.

Suffix-replace reads pattern.template || '-{N}.html', strips pattern.match ('.html'), appends template with {N} substituted. Produces /Rifles_c_17-2.html. Live-verified that -2.html?sortby=4 (sortParam query appended) returns the SAME content as the site's canonical -2-4.html path form. So the DB template -{N}.html + sortParam ?sortby=4 combination is correct and produces honored newest-first paginated pages.

coverageProof.walked: All 9 catalogUrls, full pagination via -{N}.html suffix-replace + ?sortby=4, 900ms spacing, ~85 page fetches, all HTTP 200.

Heavy intra-spine overlap (sum 670) is expected: NON-RESTRICTED/RESTRICTED are firearm-CLASS groupings overlapping the product-TYPE cats (Rifles/Shotgun/Pistols). Overlap is harmless for coverage (dedup at index time via _p_<id>). Keep RESTRICTED (200/0) per keep-empty Rule C.
